title: The Fall of Jericho

questions.question: How was Jericho described before the battle?
options: Shut up inside and outside; none went out, and none came in
questions.correctAnswer: Shut up inside and outside; none went out, and none came in
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:1 (ESV): "Now Jericho was shut up inside and outside because of the people of Israel. None went out, and none came in."

questions.question: How many priests were to bear seven trumpets of rams' horns?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:4 (ESV): "Seven priests shall bear seven trumpets of rams' horns before the ark."

questions.question: How many times were they to march around the city on the seventh day?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:4 (ESV): "On the seventh day you shall march around the city seven times..."

questions.question: What were the people commanded to do on the seventh time when the trumpets blew?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:5 (ESV): "...then all the people shall shout with a great shout..."

questions.question: What happened when the people shouted?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:20 (ESV): "...the wall fell down flat, so that the people went up into the city..."

questions.question: Who was spared from the destruction of Jericho?
options: Rahab the prostitute and all who were with her in her house
questions.correctAnswer: Rahab the prostitute and all who were with her in her house
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:22-23, 25 (ESV): "...But Rahab the prostitute... Joshua saved alive..."

questions.question: What instruction was given regarding the shout on the first six days?
options: You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard until the day I tell you
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not shout nor let your voice be heard until the day I tell you
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:10 (ESV): "You shall not shout nor make your voice to be heard... until the day I tell you to shout."

questions.question: What happened to the silver, gold, bronze, and iron found in the city?
options: They were put into the treasury of the house of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They were put into the treasury of the house of the Lord
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:24 (ESV): "...Only the silver and gold, and the vessels of bronze and of iron, they put into the treasury of the house of the Lord."

questions.question: Who burned the city with fire?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:24 (ESV): "And they burned the city with fire and everything in it..."

questions.question: Joshua pronounced a curse on anyone who would do what?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:26 (ESV): "Cursed before the Lord be the man who rises up and rebuilds this city, Jericho..."

questions.question: What was the cost of rebuilding Jericho according to the curse?
options: At the cost of his firstborn shall he lay its foundation, and his youngest set up its gates
He shall pay a talent of gold
questions.correctAnswer: At the cost of his firstborn shall he lay its foundation, and his youngest set up its gates
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:26 (ESV): "At the cost of his firstborn shall he lay its foundation, and at the cost of his youngest son shall he set up its gates."

questions.question: Who went before the priests with the trumpets?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:9 (ESV): "The armed men were walking before the priests who were blowing the trumpets..."

questions.question: Who came after the Ark?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:9 (ESV): "...and the rear guard was walking after the ark..."

questions.question: Where did they place Rahab and her family?
options: In the center of the camp
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:23 (ESV): "...and set them outside the camp of Israel."

questions.question: What is Rahab's status "to this day" (at the time of writing)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 6:25 (ESV): "...And she has lived in Israel to this day..."

key_verse_text: So the people shouted, and the trumpets were blown. As soon as the people heard the sound of the trumpet, the people shouted a great shout, and the wall fell down flat... (ESV)
